newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish October retail sales value up 5.3 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Irish October retail sales value up 5.3 pct m/m.

text.p: The value of Irish retail sales rose a provisional seasonally adjusted 5.3 percent in October, giving a year-on-year increase of 9.2 percent, Central Statistics Office (CSO) data showed on Friday.

In September, retail sales value was down 0.9 percent over the month and rose 5.6 percent year-on-year. This was revised from last month's provisional figures which showed retail sales value falling 1.4 percent on the month and rising 5.1 percent on the year.
Sales volume in September was down 1.1 percent on August and was 3.6 percent higher than in September last year.
